captions.t: Casinos are designed so you lose track of time… and money. Here's how.
One. Chips instead of cash. A plastic chip doesn't feel like real money, so it's easier to bet more.
Two. Near misses. When the slot stops one symbol away from a jackpot, brain studies show it lights up reward areas, almost like a win.
Three. Losses disguised as wins. You bet a dollar, win fifty cents, and the machine still celebrates with lights and music.
And four. Free drinks and comps. They're not gifts. They keep you playing longer.
Follow for more psychology tricks used on your wallet.
